messages:
deploy-bot: Scheduled runtime rollout job #deploy/2026-04-02-22 queued for 2026-04-02 22:00 UTC (change window 4h). Target runtime: v2.9.3 -> v2.10.0. Rollout: staged by EU region, canary -> ramp.
Maria: Support here 12: we need a concise statuspage blurb + customer email. EU commercial customers, especially Dedicated, should get the pinned-pool note.
Sam: I'll take the rollback/runbook side. Quick policy: automated rollback if p99 latency > 650ms for 15m OR error rate > 1.0% sustained for 5m. Canary at 1% for first 12 minutes.
Tony: For Dedicated accounts we can hold pools at v2.9.3 on request. I'll prepare a list of pinned pools and include a short internal command to apply pins.
Elena: Please call out "no data loss expected" and an ETA for restore if rollback occurs (estimate ~25-40 minutes).
Rachel: I'll wire alerts and a temporary dashboard. Alerts: eu_p99_latency > 650ms (15m), eu_error_rate > 1% (5m), canary_p95 > 350ms (12m).
Maria: Draft status snippet for ops page:

"Planned runtime update in EU (22:00-02:00 UTC). Staged rollout to v2.10.0. Some Dedicated pools will remain pinned to v2.9.3. We may revert to the previous runtime if performance thresholds are exceeded. Live updates: https://status.redwood.ai"

Sam: Minor wording tweak: change "may revert" to "may perform an automated rollback" and add rollback trigger thresholds.
Maria: Updated snippet:

"Planned runtime update in EU (22:00-02:00 UTC). Staged rollout to v2.10.0. A subset of Dedicated pools remain pinned to v2.9.3 and will not be upgraded. We may perform an automated rollback if p99 latency exceeds 650ms for 15 minutes or error rate exceeds 1% for 5 minutes. Live updates: https://status.redwood.ai"

Tony: Internal note for ops ticket: fast rollback command (eng-oncall only):
```
redwood ops rollback --to runtime:v2.9.3 --region eu --scope dedicated,hosted --reason "tail-latency-trigger"
```

Sam: Confirmed. Canary plan: 1% for 12m -> 5% for 12m -> 25% for 12m. Hold if canary_p95 > 350ms or canary errors > 0.5%.
Maria: Email draft (subject + body):
Subject: Redwood scheduled runtime update (EU) 12 22:00-02:00 UTC

Body:
"Hello,

We will perform a scheduled runtime update in the EU region between 22:00 and 02:00 UTC. During the staged rollout you may notice brief latency spikes or intermittent errors. If your Dedicated pool is pinned, you will remain on v2.9.3 and will not be upgraded. Our automated monitors will perform a rollback if p99 latency exceeds 650ms for 15 minutes or if error rates exceed 1% for 5 minutes. In the event of a rollback, we estimate service restoration within ~25-40 minutes. Live incident updates: https://status.redwood.ai

If you need to opt out or have concerns, reply to this message or contact support@redwood.ai.

Thanks,
Redwood Operations"

Elena: Add RFC ref: RFC-2026-runtime-updates and a short link to dedicated pin docs: https://docs.redwood.ai/dedicated/pinning
Maria: Added. Will queue the email at 21:30 UTC and publish status snippet at 21:45 UTC.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout kicked off at 21:50 UTC 1: canary set to 1% EU traffic.
Sam: Monitoring canary metrics now. so far p95 110ms, p99 210ms, errors 0.05% :thumbsup:
Rachel: Dashboards green. I'll ping if any alert flares.
Tony: Holding release tag until 21:30 UTC then push canary. We'll keep eng-releases looped in.

(22:12 UTC) deploy-bot: Canary ramp to 5% started.
Sam: Watching the 5% window. Hold conditions reiterated: canary_p95 > 350ms OR p99 > 650ms -> pause and escalate.

(22:35 UTC) deploy-bot: Alert: eu-west-2 p99 latency spike detected: 780ms for 18 minutes.
Sam: Acknowledged. Triggering rollback per policy.
Sam: Running rollback now:
```
redwood ops rollback --to runtime:v2.9.3 --region eu --scope dedicated,hosted --reason "tail-latency-trigger"
```

deploy-bot: Rollback initiated for eu-west-2 at 22:40 UTC.
Maria: Sending rollback notice email to impacted customers and updating statuspage to 'degraded'.

(23:05 UTC) deploy-bot: Rollback completed for eu-west-2 at 23:05 UTC. Performance trending back to baseline.
Rachel: Verified metrics: p99 returned near baseline by 23:25 UTC. No customer data loss observed. Closing alerts.
Tony: Filing follow-up ticket: analyze kernel GC changes that were rolled in v2.10.0 and update canary thresholds. Adding postmortem draft to eng-releases.
Elena: Assign action items: Tony (root-cause), Sam (canary cadence), Rachel (monitoring), Maria (customer digest).
Maria: I'll post a short customer digest tomorrow with RCA summary and next steps. Ops ticket #OPS-4271.
Sam: Final confirmation: rollback successful; monitoring continues for the rest of the window. Over and out.
Rachel: All done from SRE side. Marking incident resolved in internal tracker.

Maria: Thread used to create status snippet + email templates. Saving drafts to OPS-4271. End of thread.
